items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: I'm going to get one of Gerald Adams' basses.

ctx.x: That's what he said. What does that mean? I said, well, look, man. I said, I never had no experience with no bass. I tried to play nothing. I said, but just suppose I could play. I said, I don't have no bass. You see, that ain't no problem, see. I'm going to get one of Gerald Adams' basses. Gerald got three basses. He on the gig with one. I tried to get him, but he's working. So I'm going to borrow one of his other basses. He said, all you do is come down here and the bass will be on the Berenstain. So, man, I…
How did you keep up with it? I mean, physically, how did you...
